name: Support trial conversion policy example
answer:
Customers can cancel a trial before it converts to a paid plan.
Trial conversions are refunded automatically within 30 days.
Customers receive a complimentary conference ticket after the trial ends.

sources.title: Support Trial Conversion Policy
sources.content: Customers can cancel a trial before it converts to a paid plan. Trial charges can be refunded within 14 days when eligibility requirements are met.
